newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak blue chips close down, SAX off 5.14 pts.
newsitem.headline: Slovak blue chips close down, SAX off 5.14 pts.

text.p: Major Slovak shares closed lower in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Tuesday, with losses several blue chip issues pulling the SAX index down 5.14 points to 171.53.
Trading on the bourse floor was characterised by large volumes of shares traded in larger issues, but brokers said these were mostly traditional year-end accounting moves.
"All of these transfers seemed as speculative, maybe except for VSZ steel," Radovan Dzugas of Creditanstalt said.
Steel maker VSZ closed down 25 crowns at 600, on a volume of 5,985 shares.
Oil refinery Slovnaft closed down 106 crowns at 704, with 2,414 traded shares. Oil and gas storage firm Nafta closed down 180 at 1,500 crowns, on a volume of 13,082 shares.
Dzugas said the market was slowing down as trading winds up for the year on December 20.
"There will be only few deals tommorrow and hardly any until the end of week, because it takes at least three days to settle trades," he added.
Overall volume eased to 759,875 shares, from 760,144 shares traded on Monday, while turnover increased to 581.88 million crowns, from 364.87 million.
